correctness.rationale: For any positive multipartite sizes classify maximal shortest paths: if complete graph all edges and floor(N/2) matching; otherwise only 3-vertex endpoint-same-part paths and 2-vertex edges between singleton classes. With e disjoint singleton edges removed, triple number t bounded by 3t<=Q, t<=Q-max a_i, t<=sum floor(a_i/2). Sufficiency: set R=Q-2t>=t and L_i=max(0,a_i-R); algebra proves L_i<=floor(a_i/2) and sum_i L_i<=t. Allocate t pair tokens p_i within bounds and Hall-match distinct centers outside each pair class; homogeneous and mixed token subsets pass Hall. Therefore all t from 0 through bound achievable and optimize e to displayed three-term min. Independent brute graph geodesic enumeration plus exact set-packing DP matched 128 integer partitions on N=2..10; finite check is supplementary.
